items.article_context_original: Concerns over the Treasury Department's debt repurchase program continue to weigh on markets. Longer-dated U.S. government bond yields moved higher on Friday as investor jitters over the Treasury Department's extended debt repurchase program and soaring national debt continued to hover over markets. The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury bond, one of the targets of the buyback plan, rose more than 3 basis points to 5.273%. A week ago, the long bond yielded 5.21%. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield — the key benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was up more than 3 basis points at 4.734%. Last Friday, the 10-year yielded as little as 4.63%. The shorter-dated 2-year Treasury note yield, which more closely tracks short-term Federal Reserve rate expectations, was higher by more than 4 basis points at 4.232%. A week, the two-year low yield was about 4.10%. One basis point equals 0.01%, or 1/100th of 1%, and yields and prices move inversely to one another.

The move comes as Washington (TIP): The US Treasury Department said on Wednesday that it will more than double the size of its government debt buybacks. The move comes as the bond market is facing heavy pressure and Treasury yields have climbed to levels not seen in nearly 20 years. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is leading the department as it increases its role as a buyer in the government bond market, CNBC reported. The main aim is to support liquidity in the longer-term part of the Treasury market, where trading conditions have become difficult. Buybacks will target longer-term Treasury debt Under the new plan, Treasury will focus on government debt with maturities of 10 to 20 years and 20 to 30 years. These longer-term bonds have faced a buyers’ strike since late June, meaning investors have been less willing to buy them. The Treasury currently allows a maximum of $2 billion in each buyback operation. That amount will now be increased to at least $4 billion, meaning the size of the operations will at least double, according to the Treasury Department. The new plan will begin on September 9 and remain in place through November 4. Bond yields dropped after announcement Treasury’s announcement immediately pushed bond yields sharply lower, while US stock market futures moved higher. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield fell 6 basis points to 4.647%. The 30-year Treasury yield dropped 9 basis points to 5.196%. One basis point is equal to 0.01 percentage point. Treasury bond prices and yields move in opposite directions, so falling yields mean bond prices are rising. Why is the Treasury doing this? Treasury said the larger buyback operations are meant to provide more liquidity in longer-dated parts of the government bond market. The department said there is still strong interest from market participants in these longer-term bonds. items.article_context: ABD Menkul Kıymetler ve Borsa Komisyonu (SEC), CBOE BZX Borsası'nın ilk kaldıraçlı borsa yatırım fonlarını (ETF'ler) listelemeye yönelik teklifi üzerine kamuya açık bir yorum dönemi başlattı ABD Menkul Kıymetler ve Borsa Komisyonu (SEC), CBOE BZX Borsası'nın, Bitcoin ve Ethereum'un günlük getirisinin üç katına bağlı olan ABD'deki ilk kaldıraçlı borsa yatırım fonlarını (ETF'ler) listelemeye yönelik teklifi üzerine kamuya açık bir yorum dönemi başlattı. Düzenleyici kurum tarafından yayınlanan başvuru, dijital varlıkların ana akım finansal ürünlere devam eden entegrasyonunda önemli bir adıma işaret ediyor. Chicago Board Options Exchange'in hisse senedi borsası kolu olan CBOE BZX, altı kaldıraçlı ETF'yi listelemek için bir kural değişikliği teklifi sundu. Bunlara 3x Bitcoin ETF, 3x Ethereum ETF ve altın, gümüş, ham petrol ve doğal gaz için kaldıraçlı fonlar dahildir. Kaldıraçlı yapı, yatırımcılara fiyat hareketlerine daha fazla maruz kalma imkanı sunarak, dayanak varlığın performansının üç katı günlük getiri sağlamayı amaçlıyor. SEC'in teklifi kamuoyunun görüşüne açma kararı, 1934 tarihli Menkul Kıymetler Borsası Kanunu uyarınca prosedürel bir gerekliliktir. Bu, yatırımcılar, sektör profesyonelleri ve akademisyenler de dahil olmak üzere ilgili tarafların, ürünlerin borsanın listeleme standartlarını ve yatırımcı koruma gerekliliklerini karşılayıp karşılamadığı konusunda geri bildirimde bulunmalarına olanak tanır. Onaylandığı takdirde bunlar, ABD borsalarında bulunan ilk kaldıraçlı kripto ETF'ler olacak. Kaldıraçlı ETF'ler geleneksel finansta yaygın olsa da, kripto alanına girişleri perakende ve kurumsal yatırımcıların dijital varlıklara erişim şeklini önemli ölçüde değiştirebilir. Bu ürünler, temel kripto para birimini doğrudan tutmadan, potansiyel olarak piyasa likiditesini ve katılımını artırmadan, büyütülmüş risk elde etmenin bir yolunu sunar. Ancak kaldıraçlı ETF'ler, günlük yeniden dengeleme ve bileşikleştirme etkileri nedeniyle yüksek risk taşır ve bu da uzun süreler boyunca beklenmeyen kayıplara yol açabilir. SEC'in incelemesinin bu risklerin yanı sıra temel piyasanın oynaklığı ve fon sponsorunun bu tür ürünleri etkili bir şekilde yönetme becerisine odaklanması bekleniyor.

items.article_context_original: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has initiated a public comment period on a proposal by CBOE BZX Exchange to list the first leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) in The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has initiated a public comment period on a proposal by CBOE BZX Exchange to list the first leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) in the United States tied to three times the daily returns of Bitcoin and Ethereum. The filing, published by the regulatory body, marks a significant step in the ongoing integration of digital assets into mainstream financial products. CBOE BZX, the equities exchange arm of the Chicago Board Options Exchange, submitted a rule change proposal to list six leveraged ETFs. These include a 3x Bitcoin ETF, a 3x Ethereum ETF, and leveraged funds for gold, silver, crude oil, and natural gas. The leveraged structure aims to deliver daily returns that are three times the performance of the underlying asset, offering traders amplified exposure to price movements. The SEC’s decision to open the proposal for public comment is a procedural requirement under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. It allows interested parties—including investors, industry professionals, and academics—to submit feedback on whether the products meet the exchange’s listing standards and investor protection requirements. If approved, these would be the first leveraged crypto ETFs available on U.S. exchanges. While leveraged ETFs are common in traditional finance, their introduction to the crypto space could significantly alter how retail and institutional investors access digital assets. These products offer a way to gain magnified exposure without directly holding the underlying cryptocurrency, potentially increasing market liquidity and participation. However, leveraged ETFs carry heightened risk due to daily rebalancing and compounding effects, which can lead to unexpected losses over extended periods. The SEC’s scrutiny is expected to focus on these risks, as well as on the underlying market’s volatility and the ability of the fund sponsor to manage such products effectively.

Improved liquidity expectations, regulatory optimism, ETF demand and short liquidations have given the market a much-needed boost, but Bitcoin and Ethereum are still significantly below their previous cycle highs. Bitcoin price is back in focus after BTC▲$62,630.00 broke through key levels that had previously restrained the price. The rapid rise has caused bears to flee and momentum buyers to jump in. While the confluence of liquidity, sentiment, and leverage is not enough to suggest the start of a new bull market, it has made Bitcoin $70K one of the most anticipated levels in the short term. The US Treasury is doubling buybacks to $4 billion per operation for "liquidity support."The dollar dumped. BTC ripped 8.7% off the lows to $69.7k.Every operation like this draws the Terminus Line closer. #OMEGA60
items.context: Bitcoin ve Ethereum'un bugün neden yükseldiğini ve kripto rallisinde bir geri dönüş görüp görmediğimizi öğrenin. Bitcoin, 69.000 doları geri aldıktan sonra psikolojik 70.000 dolar seviyesine yaklaşmayı başardı. Bu arada Ethereum 2.300 doların üzerine çıktı ve yüzde bazında Bitcoin'den daha iyi performans gösteriyor.

items.article_context_original: Crypto prices surge as Bitcoin reclaims $68K and Ethereum tops $2,000, boosted by Treasury buybacks, ETF inflows, short liquidations and regulatory optimism. An independent digital media outlet delivering crypto research, news, and technical analysis to a community of 600,000+ users. Crypto prices surged as Bitcoin reclaimed $68,000 and Ethereum crossed $2,000, with Treasury buybacks, ETF inflows, short liquidations and regulatory optimism supporting the market rally. Crypto prices surged on Wednesday as improving liquidity conditions, short liquidations, regulatory optimism and institutional ETF inflows combined to push digital assets sharply higher. Bitcoin (BTC) climbed above $68,000, while Ethereum (ETH) reclaimed the $2,000 level during US trading. Solana (SOL), XRP, BNB, Hyperliquid (HYPE) and Dogecoin (DOGE) also advanced as the broader crypto market recovered. The rally came as Treasury buybacks eased concerns about liquidity in US debt markets, while a wave of leveraged short positions was liquidated across crypto derivatives markets.
